mentions.name: Soul Crystal
mentions.description: A revived browser-playable version of Soul Crystal, a German graphic/text adventure from 1992, built from reverse engineering work. It features an English translation, reimagined HD graphics, and voiced cutscenes.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've revived Soul Crystal, a German graphic/text adventure from 1992, based on reverse engineering work I started back in 2006. Over the past two weeks, I've turned it into a playable browser game with English translation, reimagined HD graphics, and voiced cutscenes.
mentions.author: s-macke
